series_events.detail: result DEV ONLY — NOT ENOUGH CASES

findings.claim_text: The SoundWave Pro X2 is priced at $129.99.
findings.evidence_note: The retailer page explicitly lists the price as $129.99.

findings.claim_text: It features 30 hours of total battery life with the charging case.
findings.evidence_note: The official spec sheet states "up to 30 hours of total combined listening time including the charging case," confirmed also by the press release.
The spec sheet lists "Release date: March 1, 2024," and the press release corroborates with "available starting March 1, 2024."

result.result_text:
All three factual claims on the target page have been verified. Here's a summary:

| # | Claim | Verdict | Key Source |
|---|-------|---------|------------|
| 1 | Priced at **$129.99** | ✅ SUPPORTED | Retailer page (source_2) |
| 2 | **30 hours** of total battery life with the charging case | ✅ SUPPORTED | Spec sheet (source_1) + Press release (source_3) |
| 3 | Released on **March 1, 2024** | ✅ SUPPORTED | Spec sheet (source_1) + Press release (source_3) |

Every claim on the target page is **fully supported** by the available source pages, with no contradictions or unverifiable statements found.

findings.evidence_note: The manufacturer spec sheet lists the price as $999, not $899. Per the numeric exact-match policy, this directly contradicts the claim. The retailer (source_2) also confirms $999.
The press release explicitly states the UltraBook Air 14 ships with "16GB of RAM out of the box." Also corroborated by the manufacturer spec sheet (16GB LPDDR5 RAM) and retailer listing.
The press release explicitly states the UltraBook Air 14 "ships with Windows 11 Home." Also corroborated by the manufacturer spec sheet listing "Windows 11 Home" as the operating system.

result.result_text:
All three claims on the target page have been verified. Here's a summary of the findings:

| # | Claim | Verdict | Reason |
|---|-------|---------|--------|
| 1 | Priced at **$899** | ❌ **CONTRADICTED** | All authoritative sources (manufacturer spec sheet & retailer) consistently list the price as **$999**, not $899. |
| 2 | Comes with **16GB RAM** | ✅ **SUPPORTED** | Confirmed by all three sources — press release, manufacturer spec sheet (16GB LPDDR5), and retailer listing. |
| 3 | Ships with **Windows 11 Home** | ✅ **SUPPORTED** | Confirmed by both the press release and the manufacturer spec sheet. |

**Key issue:** The price claim on the target page is off by $100 — it states $899 when every source agrees the correct price is $999.
